title: Tidy hierarchy tree
intent: Show a small product hierarchy with a tidy node-link layout and direct labels.

ai.create: Create a left-to-right tidy hierarchy from typed slash-delimited paths with one link per parent-child relationship, one dot per node, and direct node labels. Plot should use its native tree mark; TanStack should pass granular d3-hierarchy layout output to ordinary link, dot, and text marks.
ai.maintain: Change the hierarchy depth and labels while preserving stable path identity, the raw flat path rows, mirrored branch and leaf labels, granular d3-hierarchy imports, and cast-free channels.
